title: Tunisian Chicken Wrap
description: A healthy and smoky Tunisian-inspired chicken wrap recipe, perfect for a quick meal on-the-go.
instructions: 1. Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. In a small bowl, mix together smoked paprika, cumin, coriander, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
3. Rub the spice mixture all over the chicken breast, making sure to coat it evenly.
4. Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F.
5. Let the chicken rest for a few minutes before slicing it thinly.
6. Warm the wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds, or in the oven for a few minutes.
7. Assemble the wrap by placing the sliced chicken, cooked rice, and any desired toppings (such as lettuce, tomato, and pickles) into the center of the wrap.
8. Drizzle with your favorite sauce (such as tahini or hummus) and serve immediately.
